Unidentified Woman's Body Found in Hazaribagh Pond

The body of an unidentified woman was discovered in the Hurhuru pond in Hazaribagh. Police have initiated an investigation into the matter. Another report states the body was found in Danua Valley, Hazaribagh, with a bullet wound on the forehead and a sari and handkerchief wrapped around the neck, causing alarm.
